title: Senior Brand Manager - KSA
description:
Who We Are
moomoo is an investment platform of Futu Holdings (Nasdaq: FUTU) — a technology-driven brokerage serving millions of retail investors across the Hongkong, US, Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and Canada. As we enter the Saudi Arabian market, we are not simply localizing a product. We are building a brand from the ground up in one of the world's fastest-growing capital markets, backed by Vision 2030's ambition to raise Saudi retail investor participation.
This is a rare opportunity to be the person who defines what moomoo means to Saudi investors — before anyone else does.

The Role
We are looking for a Senior Brand Manager who operates at the intersection of long-term brand building and commercial growth.
You will be moomoo's brand architect in Saudi Arabia — owning the positioning, the narrative, the visual identity, and the cultural credibility that converts brand awareness into investor trust, and investor trust into business results.
The right person holds two things simultaneously: the patience to build a brand that compounds over years, and the urgency to make this quarter's numbers move. Preferably — you are an investor yourself. You understand what it feels like to open a brokerage account for the first time, to watch a position move, to make a decision under uncertainty.

What You Will Own

Brand Positioning & User Mindset
Define moomoo's brand positioning in the Saudi market — who we are for, what we stand for, and why that matters to a Saudi investor
Build a deep, empathetic understanding of Saudi retail investors: their financial aspirations, media habits, trust signals, and cultural reference points
Translate moomoo's product strengths into a locally resonant brand promise, in both Arabic and English

Brand-Growth Integration
Partner with Growth, Product, and Business Development to ensure brand strategy directly supports user acquisition, activation, and retention goals
Set and own brand KPIs (awareness, recall, share of voice, brand equity) alongside commercial KPIs — accountable to both
Identify where brand investment creates the highest commercial leverage; make the case for resource prioritization with data

Brand Asset Management & Consistency
Establish and govern moomoo's Saudi brand identity system: tone of voice, visual standards, content principles — in Arabic and English
Ensure brand consistency across every touchpoint: app, social, OOH, PR, partnerships, events, and customer communications

Content Judgment & Integrated Marketing
Lead integrated brand campaigns with a strong editorial and aesthetic point of view
Commission and direct creative output (copy, design, video) — you don't need to produce it, but you need to know when it's right and when it's not
Oversee localization of global campaigns to ensure cultural authenticity, not just translation

Investor Empathy & Financial Communication
Deeply understand the psychology of Saudi retail investors — first-time investors, young professionals, active traders
Translate complex financial products into compelling, accessible brand narratives that build confidence, not confusion
Ensure all brand communications reflect Islamic finance principles and CMA regulatory requirements

Cross-Cultural Collaboration & Organizational Drive
Work closely with moomoo's regional and global teams based in Singapore, Hong Kong, and China — bridging local market insight with global brand direction
Navigate the fast-moving, iterative decision-making culture typical of Chinese internet companies: responsive communication, short feedback loops, high execution velocity
Manage external agencies, creative partners, and media vendors; hold them to brand standards and timelines
Build and lead the local brand team as the Saudi operation scales

Requirements

Who You Are
o Saudi national · Native Arabic speaker · Professional-level English (written and spoken)
o 5+ years in brand management, marketing strategy, or integrated communications
o Background in financial services, fintech, or a high-trust consumer brand — investment product experience is a strong advantage
o Active investor yourself, with personal experience in equities — US stock market familiarity strongly preferred. You don't just market to investors; you think like one.
· Your working style
o You have worked in or closely with a Chinese technology or internet company — this will be a strong advantage. You understand the pace, the communication directness, the expectation of fast iteration, and the ambition.
o You are energized, not frustrated, by the dynamic between a fast-moving HQ and a market-building local team.
o Low ego. You care more about the brand winning than about being credited for the win. You take feedback well and give it clearly.
o Lifelong learner. The investment industry, the Saudi market, and the competitive landscape are all moving fast. You read, you stay curious, you update your views when the evidence changes.
· Hard Skills
o Brand strategy and positioning development
o Consumer and competitive insight generation
o Content and visual quality judgment — you brief creatives precisely and give decisive feedback
o Brand asset governance and identity management
o Channel fluency: social, digital, OOH, PR, events, influencer
o Financial and product literacy sufficient to review investment-related content with accuracy
· Soft Skills & Mindset
o Long-term brand conviction paired with short-term commercial accountability
o Strong aesthetic sensibility with a clear point of view
o Cross-functional influence without formal authority
o Structured thinker who moves fast without losing brand coherence
o Comfortable with ambiguity, limited resources, and high-stakes decisions in a market-entry environment
· Local Market Knowledge
o Fluency in the Saudi media landscape: platforms, key voices, cultural calendar, regulatory environment
o Familiarity with CMA and SAMA guidelines as they relate to financial marketing
o Understanding of Vision 2030's capital market agenda and how it shapes consumer financial behavior

Benefits

Private Health Insurance
Pension Plan
Paid Time Off
Training & Development
Performance Bonus

title: Marketing Manager
description:
Position: Marketing Manager
Location: Riyadh, KSA
About the role: As the Marketing Manager for the KSA market, you will be responsible for building the brand awareness and build the funnel with the goal of bring good quality of leads. This role plays a critical part in developing and executing localized marketing strategies, strengthening brand visibility, managing public relations, supporting dealer marketing activities, and ensuring efficient budget management. The ideal candidate should have strong strategic thinking, excellent communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
Reports to: Marketing & PR Director Americas & Europe & MEA
Subordinates: None
Authority: None
Key responsibilities:
Marketing Strategy and Planning
Develop and execute marketing strategies and annual marketing plans for the KSA market in alignment with business objectives and Global Marketing Strategic Guidelines.

Brand Promotion and Awareness
Collaborate closely with the Middle East regional Marketing, PR, and Event teams to execute integrated marketing activities across the KSA, including national events, exhibitions, media campaigns, digital marketing, and lifestyle partnerships, to enhance brand awareness and market influence.

Public Relations
Build and maintain strong relationships with local media, press, agencies, KOLs, influencers, and key industry stakeholders in coordination with the PR team to ensure strong brand visibility, positive reputation, and effective storytelling for the brand and products. Handle PR-related issues and crisis communication promptly and professionally.
Dealer Marketing Management
Supervise dealer marketing plans and local activations across the KSA network. Provide dealers with marketing guidance, campaign support, and performance follow-up to ensure alignment with brand standards and business objectives.

Market Research and Analysis
Conduct in-depth market analysis to understand customer trends, competitor activities, and market opportunities within the KSA automotive industry. Evaluate campaign and event performance, generate actionable insights, and continuously optimize marketing effectiveness.

Budget Management
Manage and monitor the marketing budget effectively, ensuring efficient allocation of resources and maximizing return on investment (ROI) across all marketing activities.

Brand Ambassador
Act as the brand ambassador within the KSA automotive and lifestyle industry, representing the brand at key events, media engagements, and industry networking opportunities.

Localization and Compliance Management
Ensure all dealer websites, retail signage, digital assets, and marketing materials are properly localized for the KSA market, culturally relevant, up to date, and fully compliant with BYD CI guidelines and local regulations.

Required Skills, Qualifications and Experience
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related field.
* Minimum 8 years of experience in marketing communications, with solid experience in the automotive industry (OEM experience preferred).
* Strong understanding of the KSA market, consumer behavior, and local media landscape.
* Experience managing integrated marketing campaigns, PR activities, events, and dealer marketing operations.
* Customer-centric mindset aligned with the mission of promoting sustainable mobility and innovation.
* Fluent in English; Arabic language skills would be a strong advantage. Chinese language skills are a plus.
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across multicultural and cross-functional teams.
* Results-oriented, proactive, and adaptable to a fast-growing and dynamic business environment.

title: Client Partnerships & Growth Director

About Us

Our heritage is built upon a century of combined expertise, where creativity meets technology, and diverse perspectives ignite inspiration. With the merger of VMLY&R and Wunderman Thompson, we have forged a new path as a growth partner that is part creative agency, part consultancy, and part technology powerhouse.

Position Overview

Lead and grow strategic client relationships by connecting business and marketing priorities with technology-enabled solutions that deliver measurable commercial and customer value.

The Client Partnerships Director is accountable for the growth, commercial health, and long-term success of priority client relationships, while developing opportunities with prospective clients. You will understand clients’ business, customer, marketing, and transformation priorities and use that insight to shape integrated solutions that create measurable value.

Using a consultative and commercially focused approach, you will develop multi-year account strategies, build trusted relationships across client organisations, identify and convert growth opportunities, and orchestrate cross-functional teams. You will apply practical knowledge of marketing technology, data, CRM, content, commerce, and customer experience to connect business needs with technology-enabled solutions.

Business and Client Leadership:
Own the strategic direction, commercial health, and growth plan for a portfolio of priority clients, with accountability for revenue, profitability, retention, and client satisfaction.
Develop a deep understanding of clients’ business models, customer priorities, marketing agendas, operating environments, and transformation ambitions.

Identify, shape, and convert opportunities across existing and prospective clients by bringing together the right VML capabilities to achieve defined business outcomes.

MarTech and Transformation Advisory:
Advise clients on how marketing technology, data, CRM, content, commerce, and customer experience capabilities can drive growth, improve marketing effectiveness, and strengthen customer engagement.
Experience translating client priorities into commercially compelling proposals, roadmaps, and technology-enabled solutions.

Navigate complex stakeholder environments, align differing priorities, and serve as the senior point of escalation for commercial, relationship, or delivery matters.
Lead strategic reviews and QBRs that demonstrate business impact, surface insights, and establish shared priorities and next steps.

Act as the voice of the client internally, giving cross-functional teams clear business context, priorities, and success measures.
Collaborate with delivery leaders to maintain governance, manage risk, resolve issues, and meet strategic, commercial, and operational expectations.

Qualifications & Experience

6+ years of experience leading client relationships, commercial growth, and transformation engagements within an agency, consultancy, MarTech, or enterprise technology environment.
Demonstrable track record of owning and growing client relationships, ideally with government or semi-government organisations.
Proven success in developing senior stakeholder relationships, shaping strategic opportunities, and securing significant multi-year engagements.
Strong commercial management experience across account planning, pipeline, forecasting, negotiation, pricing, and scope governance.
Experience collaborating with integrated, cross-functional teams and managing engagements in complex, multi-vendor environments.
Practical experience across MarTech, CRM, data, content, commerce, customer experience, or digital transformation, with the credibility to engage business and technology stakeholders.
Experience translating client business and marketing priorities into briefs, roadmaps, proposals, and technology-enabled solutions.

MarTech Fluency: Connects marketing technology ecosystems and capabilities to business and marketing outcomes.

Curious – Seeks to understand people, businesses, and how they engage with content and technology.
Agile – Anticipates requirements, manages expectations, and finds practical ways through problems.

Passionate, driven people - We champion a culture where people do extraordinary work.

Growth-minded opportunities - We nurture a culture of real-time feedback, a growth-oriented mindset, and training opportunities through VML and WPP, so you can continue to grow personally and professionally.

Architect the creative engine as a system: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, and whitelisting. Design capital allocation on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages. Design promo architecture across the retail calendar: pulse strategy, financing offers, funnel alignment. Identify, evaluate, and pilot paid channels beyond Google and Meta. Structure the performance marketing function itself. Shape the future of performance marketing at Puffy, where paid media is the primary growth lever.

What Is In It For You:
This isn't just another performance marketing role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.

You set the strategy, build the systems, and own the outcomes.

You allocate multi-million-dollar monthly budgets across Google and Meta on marginal return rather than platform-reported averages, design the pause/hold/scale logic and budget guardrails that govern all paid spend, and serve as the single source of truth on paid media performance. Creative runs as a system you architect: concept pipeline, testing taxonomy, briefs, hook/hold analytics, UGC, whitelisting.

🌍 Great Place to Work Certified
